entities.summary: Jalen Maurice Pickett is an American professional basketball player for the Denver Nuggets of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Siena Saints and the Penn State Nittany Lions. He is a graduate of SPIRE Institute and Academy, an Olympic training center in Geneva, Ohio.
